reasoning_summary: The old PDF explicitly called matched-L a preregistered sole-primary endpoint, retained primary/confirmatory hierarchy language throughout, and described differences among complete scoring protocols. The new PDF removes those assertions everywhere: it labels all reported analyses exploratory and descriptive; replaces primary/endpoint roles with foregrounded, displayed, post-selected, one-schedule, aggregate, and post-hoc statuses; states that no accessible registration establishes prospective status; and says prospective, confirmatory, prespecified-family, and complete-reporting labels are precluded. It consistently distinguishes five source-defined protocols from four protocols with disclosed outcomes and explicitly names anti_inject as having no reported outcome. The source, claim map, method provenance, and experiment registry agree with the rendered PDF. Residual uses of “complete” are properly scoped to missing ledgers/matrices, a formal definition of the realized-trace variable, or a requirements checklist explicitly disclaimed as present evidence; none asserts complete reporting.
remaining_action: None for A14-A03. Recovering timestamped registration and the anti_inject outcome would be necessary only to restore prospective or complete five-protocol status, which the revised paper no longer claims.
